measurement.source: existing desktop db-metrics.cjs and createLifecycleQueryCounter, one compiled primary API PID
measurement.scope: all pg.Client.query calls and connection protocol bytes between each pair of snapshots
exclusions: PG connection handshake and TCP/TLS overhead
measurement.cache: ordinary Better Auth signed browser/native session cache; no clearing or invented proof
measurement.workspace: original fixture team default; REST verifies that team and obtains the real personal-home transport; no workspace switch or fabricated selector
measurement.interpretation: sequential decomposition only; not an exact allocation of the earlier concurrent Native minus Web query difference
measurement.background: all primary API background traffic is included; gaps are reported, never subtracted
measurement.protocol: ordinary leased email auth, real PKCE/owned loopback and source-owned local gateway; no browser, provider challenge, daemon or VM
measurement.taskReads: separate task/thread/chat reads, then one real batch with the same returned cursors; no Live socket or simulated catch-up
measurement.comparisons: desktop.session rows are additional action comparisons, not part of an observed login total

counter.process: single compiled primary API for this sequential HTTP diagnostic

readCosts.comparison: sequential warm-request observations; not an allocation of the concurrent Native login window
